description: This file defines the CassandraToSqlColumn class, which provides methods and data structures for mapping Cassandra database columns to SQL columns, including data type conversions and value extraction/set operations.

classes.name: CassandraToSqlColumn
classes.description: Represents a mapping between a Cassandra column and an SQL column, including data type, index, and conversion methods.

methods.name: idColumn
methods.description: Creates a CassandraToSqlColumn instance for an ID column.

methods.name: stringColumn
methods.description: Creates a CassandraToSqlColumn instance for a string column.

methods.name: bigintColumn
methods.description: Creates a CassandraToSqlColumn instance for a BIGINT column.

methods.name: doubleColumn
methods.description: Creates a CassandraToSqlColumn instance for a DOUBLE column.

methods.name: booleanColumn
methods.description: Creates a CassandraToSqlColumn instance for a BOOLEAN column.

methods.name: jsonColumn
methods.description: Creates a CassandraToSqlColumn instance for a JSON column.

methods.name: enumToIntColumn
methods.description: Creates a CassandraToSqlColumn instance for an ENUM to integer conversion.

methods.name: getColumnValue
methods.description: Extracts the column value from a Cassandra Row object, converting based on the column type.

methods.name: setColumnValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a PreparedStatement parameter based on the column's value and type.
